description:
Outcome: All brief acceptance conditions are demonstrated before release (brief.md: First version must, Rules, Constraints).
Scope: Integrated PostgreSQL regression, mail sandbox, mobile/keyboard/readability checks, races and authorization; repeatable 40-plot fixtures with >40 applications. Excludes: invented performance SLAs.
Acceptance: All five requirements and three rules have passing evidence; sign-in/digest failures recover; gardeners cannot access others' contacts/reports/dashboard; grid usable on phone; failures fixed or release blocked.
Behaviour: Exercise empty/loading/failure/recovery states, focus and clear validation.
Verification: Record automated commands/results and manual browser/phone checklist; check permissions in HTML/API/mail. Prerequisites: T-008, T-009, T-010, T-013, T-014, T-015. Assumptions: target browsers set in T-001.
title: Verify first-version journeys, privacy and accessibility
